definitions.explanation: A prefix used to describe something of small to medium scale, most commonly used with businesses.

examples.japanese: {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう}を{支援|しえん}する。
examples.english: To support small and medium-sized enterprises.

examples.japanese: {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう}は{日本|にほん}{経済|けいざい}の{基盤|きばん}だ。
examples.english: Small and medium enterprises are the foundation of the Japanese economy.

examples.japanese: {中小|ちゅうしょう}の{会社|かいしゃ}でも{海外|かいがい}{展開|てんかい}ができる。
examples.english: Even small and medium-sized companies can expand overseas.

notes:
{中小|ちゅうしょう} combines {中|ちゅう} (medium) and {小|しょう} (small). Almost always used as a prefix before nouns, especially in business and economic contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう}: small and medium enterprises (SMEs)
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業庁|きぎょうちょう}: Small and Medium Enterprise Agency
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}メーカー: small-to-mid-size manufacturer
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}{規模|きぼ}: small-to-medium scale

USAGE:
{中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう} is by far the most common compound. SMEs make up over 99% of Japanese businesses, so this term appears frequently in news, policy, and economic discussions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大|だい}{企業|きぎょう}: large enterprise
- {零細|れいさい}{企業|きぎょう}: micro enterprise (even smaller than {中小|ちゅうしょう})
- {大手|おおて}: major company (commonly used in business news)
